text: plugin-fast-adapt 是一款面向 DSH 插件开发者的升级适配与诊断工具，可作为命令行技能使用，也能挂载到 Web 或桌面端 DSH。它通过原生 Cordis 服务、Agent 工具和斜杠命令提供插件审计、环境体检、内存冒烟及插件集群巡检；配套工作流还能扫描官方升级指南并生成五种形态的插件脚手架。适合维护 DSH 插件、排查宿主升级后兼容问题或批量盘点插件的开发者。需要 Node.js 22.13 或更高版本，不需要额外 API 密钥；获取上游版本和指南时会访问 npm registry 与 GitHub。

plugin-fast-adapt helps DSH developers handle plugin upgrades. Its CLI and native service scan compatibility, inspect environments, run smoke checks, and report plugin fleets. Scripts scaffold five forms. Requires Node.js 22.13+, no API key; guide data uses npm and GitHub.

plugin-fast-adapt 的功能「升级变更扫描」：读取官方升级指南中的包名、成员和常量锚点，扫描插件源码并列出命中位置与修复动作。通过适配工作流触发。
plugin-fast-adapt 的功能「插件审计」：分析插件的性能、依赖弹性、工具上下文预算和生命周期等维度，生成分项评分与问题报告。可从原生服务或审计命令调用。
plugin-fast-adapt 的功能「宿主环境诊断」：探测 DSH 安装版本、profile 覆盖层和已安装插件状态，输出环境诊断信息。可通过原生服务或诊断工作流使用。
plugin-fast-adapt 的功能「插件脚手架」：按 tool、hook、service、config 或 llm-adapter 形态生成插件文件与命名，并提供相应验证流程。通过脚手架命令创建新项目。
plugin-fast-adapt 的功能「集群巡检」：发现工作区插件或本机已安装插件，按客户端和运行状态分类，生成结构化巡检报告。通过 fleet-sweep 工作流触发。
plugin-fast-adapt 获取上游版本标签和指南时访问 npm registry 与 GitHub；环境诊断和代码扫描还需读取本机 DSH 与目标插件目录。
plugin-fast-adapt 提供命令 fast-adapt [target]：运行快速适配与环境诊断
plugin-fast-adapt 提供命令 fast-audit [target]：审查插件防御性架构与生命周期

> **DSH 每次发新版，老插件就可能启动不了。** 这个技能直连 DeepSeek 官方升级指南，扫你的插件代码，报出踩了哪几条破坏性变更、官方给的修法是什么；还能一条命令从零造出可运行的插件。**已适配到 0.2.2-rc.1**：该版官方还没写指南条目，官方 Release Note 被当作虚拟指南一并纳入，因此覆盖度仍判 `complete=true`；再新的版本如果既无指南也无发布说明，账本会明说「不能当查干净」。支持本地环境权威锚定、Release Note 破坏性变更提取与整机集群多维批量治理。

plugin-fast-adapt README · 它解决什么：DSH（DeepSeek Harness）是一个「所有功能都以插件形式存在」的 AI 运行框架，麻烦在于每次发新版，老插件就可能启动不了。常见的应对是手写升级卡片：每个版本区间写几十张卡，记清什么坏了、怎么修。这条路有三个绕不过去的问题：

1. **卡片写完就过时**。上游一次跃迁能改动数千个文件，卡片之间还有覆盖不到的「走廊缺口」。
2. **大知识库挤占推理空间**。论文实测，弱模型（qwen3.8-27b）带全套卡片库答题，56 题等权差 -3.07 pp（7 题改善、18 题退化、31 题持平）。
3. **验证太贵**。改一次验一次要等真宿主冷启动，实测有过 3600 秒超时；宿主升级后 profiles 覆盖层残留旧包，还会导致插件装载冲突。

plugin-fast-adapt README · 它解决什么：本项目的取舍是：**不维护知识，只维护取知识的方法。** 破坏性变更的权威描述在 DeepSeek 官方仓库的 `docs/upgrade-guide/<版本>/<主题>/guide.md`，官方发版时同步更新，格式固定（`## Change` 讲什么变了，`## Migration` 讲怎么改）；版本信息在 npm registry 的 `dist-tags`。两处都是官方源，所以上游发新版的那一刻，这个技能就自动跟上了。

plugin-fast-adapt README · 优势：- **适配到 0.2.2-rc.1**：直连官方 `docs/upgrade-guide/` 与 Release Notes。官方指南只写到 0.2.2-alpha.3，0.2.2-rc.1 由 Release Note 转成虚拟指南补上（该 Release Note 两万七千余字，含完整破坏性变更段），所以覆盖度仍判全覆盖；支持虚拟指南自动生成与三元版本账本快速探测
- **本地环境权威锚定（零网络依赖）**：默认定版本严格收敛到本机已安装的 DSH 宿主版本（方案 B，零外部网络请求），免除官方源网络波动与 GitHub 频控影响；显式 `--check-upstream` 才核对上游
- **集群全域多维治理看板**：新增 `fleet-sweep.mjs`，一键扫描整机 Web 插件、APP 桌面端插件、工作区源码与运行中服务，输出五大生命周期矩阵看板，支持 `--apply-compat` 批量安全修补
- **误报与低级错误硬守卫**：
  - 四层降噪 + 常量词边界正则匹配（避免 `ABORTED` 误伤 `FS_ABORTED`）
  - 虚拟 Release 指南与官方真实指南自动去重
  - 未构建 TypeScript 插件硬拦截（未见 `lib/index.js` 等入口即阻断并指引 `pnpm run build`）
  - 宿主同名内置包遮蔽（Bundle Resolution Shadow）检测，防官方同名包静默覆盖
  - 宿主冷启动退出码 143（`SIGTERM`）优雅停机正常判定，杜绝假死误报
  - 冒烟自动解析 Schemastery `Config({})` 填充默认值，未安装 node_modules 的单文件插件自动挂载宿主依赖兜底
- **跨平台与容器自适应**：消除绝对路径硬编码，扩展适配 Linux 发行版标准路径（`/usr/lib/node_modules`）、Termux 移动端（`$PREFIX/lib/node_modules`）与 `npm_config_prefix`，支持环境变量 `DSH_HOST_PATH` / `DSH_LOCATION` 直接覆盖，严格遵循 XDG 缓存规范
- **验证便宜**：内存级 Cordis 冒烟毫秒到秒级出结果，不用真宿主冷启动；需要真证据时 `--real-smoke` 再补干净 profile 真装真启档
- **零外部依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块加 `git`/`npm` 命令，没有 TypeScript、没有 AST 库、没有网络请求库
- **可复现**：243 项自检离线可跑；CI 在 push 和 PR 上跑 ubuntu/macOS/Windows 三平台，打 tag

plugin-fast-adapt README · 四条车道：主入口只做路由，四条车道各管一件事，按意图读对应文档，不一次把四份都读进来：

```
SKILL.md                      主技能：判断走哪条 + 一键编排 + 跨车道纪律
sub-skills/adapt/SKILL.md     升级适配：定版本 → 取指南 → 扫命中 → 接缝 → 秒验 → 体检
sub-skills/build/SKILL.md     造插件：scaffold 五形态 + write-gate 体检门
sub-skills/diagnose/SKILL.md  环境与启动故障：env-doctor + log-doctor + env-heal

`build`、`diagnose` 与 `review` 还各有一个顶层别名，可以让它们独立响应触发词（不建也能用，主技能会按意图读对应车道文档）：

plugin-fast-adapt README · 四条车道：```sh
ln -s <repo>/sub-skills/build    ~/.agents/skills/dsh-plugin-build
ln -s <repo>/sub-skills/diagnose ~/.agents/skills/dsh-plugin-diagnose
ln -s <repo>/sub-skills/review   ~/.agents/skills/dsh-plugin-review
```

别名的作用是让「造插件」「装了没生效」和「代码审查」这几类独立目标有自己的触发面，不必挤在主技能一个 description 里。宿主加载器对 `description` 有 1024 字符硬上限，超了整条技能会被丢弃而不是截断——这条现在由自检门禁守住。

plugin-fast-adapt README · 扫描精度：从 12 处误报到 0：初版用朴素正则，扫一个真实插件报了 12 处命中，逐一核对后**12 处全是误报**。现在的版本做了四层降噪，同一个插件的命中是 0：

- 扫描器用状态机跳过注释和字符串，注释里的同名词不算命中
- 完整点链优先，丢掉 `ctx.tools` 这种过于通用的父链
- 通用词（`register`、`resolve`、`readFile`）和短名不进锚点表；识别「旧 → 新」替换对，插件用了新符号说明已适配，不再报
- 常量锚点只从 `Change` 段抽；匹配时要求对象部分互为后缀，`engines.dsh` 不会撞 `result.dsh`
- 包名词义门：包名只在与移除/改名动词同句时才成为锚点，语境引用（「The mode fields of X accept only …」讲字段取值）不算——实测 dsh-files 的 3 处 critical 全是这类误报，加门后归零
section: 扫描精度：从 12 处误报到 0

text: plugin-fast-adapt README · 扫描精度：从 12 处误报到 0：命中带 `severity`（package=critical、member=high、code=medium，先修排前面的）、`evidence`（命中行原文，核对误报不用开文件）和出处锚点（`guideFile`/`guideLine`，直达官方指南原文位置）。规则与实测依据见 [references/heuristics.md](references/heuristics.md)。扫描根取源码根并集（`src` 与同级 `client`/`web`/`ui`），`lib`/`dist` 构建产物不重复扫。冒烟验证会披露 Mock 兜底：输出里的 `mockFallbacks` 列出插件摸到但 Mock 没提供的属性，这个列表越长，冒烟结果可信度越低——**冒烟通过 ≠ 宿主兼容**，这句话写在输出里，不只写在文档里。冒烟还按真 Cordis 契约拦未声明 `inject` 的宿主服务访问（`inject_contract` 阶段），不再让「装载即崩」的代码静默通过。要真宿主证据时用 `run.mjs --real-smoke`：桥接原仓库 plugin-upgrade 的 `verify-runtime.mjs`，干净 profile 安装→启动→四类归因（脚本不在本机时诚实跳过给补法）。

plugin-fast-adapt README · What problem it solves：DSH (DeepSeek Harness) is an AI runtime framework where everything is a plugin, and the trouble is that every new release can break existing plugins. The common workaround is hand-written upgrade cards: dozens of cards per version range, each recording what broke and how to fix it. That path has three problems it cannot get around:

plugin-fast-adapt README · What problem it solves：1. **Cards go stale the moment they are written**. A single upstream jump can touch thousands of files, and there are "corridor gaps" the cards never cover.
2. **A large knowledge base crowds out reasoning**. In the paper's evaluation a weaker model (qwen3.8-27b) scored -3.07 pp worse with the full card library loaded (equal-weight difference over 56 tasks: 7 improved, 18 regressed, 31 flat).
3. **Verification is expensive**. Every change needs a real host cold start (a 3,600-second timeout is on record), and stale packages left in the profiles overlay after a host upgrade break plugin loading.

plugin-fast-adapt README · What problem it solves：This project takes a different approach: **maintain the method of obtaining knowledge, not the knowledge itself.** The authoritative description of breaking changes lives in the vendor harness repository at `docs/upgrade-guide/<version>/<topic>/guide.md`, updated with each release in a fixed format (`## Change` for what changed, `## Migration` for how to fix it); version information lives in the npm registry's `dist-tags`. Both are vendor sources, so the skill catches up the moment upstream ships.

plugin-fast-adapt README · Advantages：- **Adapted through 0.2.2-rc.1**: reads the official `docs/upgrade-guide/` and Release Notes directly. The guide stops at 0.2.2-alpha.3, so 0.2.2-rc.1 is covered by converting its official Release Note (27k+ characters, with a full breaking-changes section) into a virtual guide; that is why coverage still reads complete. Also generates virtual guides and speeds up scans with a 3-tuple compatibility ledger
- **Local environment authority anchoring (zero network reliance)**: defaults to the locally installed DSH host version (Plan B, 0 external network requests), eliminating upstream network jitters and GitHub rate limits; uses `--check-upstream` for explicit check
- **Fleet multi-dimensional governance board**: introduces `fleet-sweep.mjs` to inspect workspace code, installed Web plugins, APP desktop plugins, and active processes in a multi-stage life-cycle matrix, with `--apply-compat` batch safe patching
- **Hard guards against false positives & unbuilt traps**:
  - Four noise-reduction layers + regex word boundaries (preventing `ABORTED` matching `FS_ABORTED`)
  - Virtual release note & official guide deduplication
  - Unbuilt TypeScript plug

plugin-fast-adapt README · Scan accuracy: from 12 false positives to 0：- The scanner uses a state machine to skip comments and strings, so a name mentioned in a comment is not a hit
- Full member chains win; overly generic parent chains like `ctx.tools` are dropped
- Generic words (`register`, `resolve`, `readFile`) and short names never become anchors; "old → new" replacement pairs are recognized, so a plugin already using the new symbol is not reported
- Constant anchors come only from the `Change` section; matching requires the object parts to be mutual suffixes, so `engines.dsh` never collides with `result.dsh`
- Package semantic gate: a package name becomes an anchor only when mentioned in a sentence with a removal/renaming verb — contextual mentions ("The mode fields of X accept only …", about field values) do not count. All 3 criticals reported on dsh-files were of this kind; the gate zeroed them

Audit scores, high/medium findings, mockFallbacks and the not-yet-mounted fact all land in the discretion section labelled for human judgment — the tool never says "qualified" on your behalf. Guide discovery reuses the guide-sync cache (zero network); a new plugin is scanned against the full historical corridor; pass `--skip-smoke` right after scaffolding to skip the duplicate smoke run.

plugin-fast-adapt README · Safety posture：- `env-doctor`, `code-scan`, `plugin-audit`, `log-doctor`, `seams` and `run-log` are strictly read-only
- `env-heal` is dry-run by default and moves rather than deletes when applied (into `~/.dsh/.trash/<date>/`)
- `sync-skill` writes to a downstream skill directory explicitly, copying only the fixed skill surface (`SKILL.md`/`README*`/`references`/`scripts`/`sub-skills`); `--check`/`--dry-run` let you inspect first
- Never modifies DSH itself, nor config or profile declarations under `~/.dsh`
- Never edits plugin code automatically; it reports findings and vendor fixes only, and `--peer-patch` prints rather than applies
- Network is used only for "fetching vendor sources": version resolution reads npm `dist-tags`, guide fetching clones the official repo. Both have timeouts and report failures explicitly instead of silently skipping; `dist-tags` is cached for 1 hour and degrades to the stale cache with a `stale` marker; guides reuse an existing local clone first, and `--no-clone` skips the fetch

plugin-fast-adapt README · Legacy plugins：The official upgrade guide only goes back to dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2. For older plugins, follow the [legacy migration SOP](references/legacy-migration-sop.md): use the upstream [plugin-upgrade skill](https://github.com/oh-my-dsh/dsh-plugin-upgrade-skill/tree/main/skills/plugin-upgrade)'s hand-curated card corridor (from dsh-v0.1.0-rc.8 on) as the difference source and walk a seven-stage checklist (mode → read-only prep → ghost-host check → corridor assembly → seven touchpoint classes → plan & confirm → six-layer validation). The SOP references rather than copies the cards, so renamed cards are caught by the self-test's dead-link assertion.

plugin-fast-adapt README · Known limitations：- The official upgrade guide does not cover every breaking change (package retirement is one class that is not documented there); the `env-doctor` overlay inspection covers that case
- Same-named symbols can still collide (a plugin's `path.resolve()` versus the guide's `runtime.resolve()`) and require human judgment of the surrounding code
- Static matching only, no runtime-behaviour verification; the smoke mock covers the common host surface only
- The ghost-host check covers CLI host processes only: Windows has no `ps etime`, and desktop Electron renderers are excluded; both cases report `unknown` with the reason instead of guessing

plugin-fast-adapt README · Provenance and division of work：This project was split out of [oh-my-dsh/dsh-plugin-upgrade-skill](https://github.com/oh-my-dsh/dsh-plugin-upgrade-skill) (a skill collection that teaches AI agents to upgrade DSH plugins, with an [arXiv paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30120)) via git subtree and has evolved independently since. As of 2026-10-26, the upstream project carries 198 upgrade cards, 12 skills and a 65-case auto-graded benchmark.

The two projects complement each other:

plugin-fast-adapt README · Provenance and division of work：| Aspect | Upstream | This project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Difference source | Hand-maintained upgrade cards | Official `docs/upgrade-guide/` + npm `dist-tags`, updates with upstream automatically |
| New release ships | Wait for cards, corridor gaps in between | Works immediately, zero changes needed |
| Verifying one change | Real host cold start, measured up to 3,600 s | In-memory Cordis smoke test, milliseconds to seconds |
| Stale overlay packages | Manual troubleshooting | `env-doctor` inspection + `env-heal` healing (dry-run by default) |
| Weaker models | Full card library in context, -3.07 pp | Six independent scripts, one small output each |
| Code-level scanning | None | Anchor matching + four noise-reduction layers |
| Fleet-wide sweep | `plugin-fleet-sweep` owns breadth | The six-step pipeline owns depth |

plugin-fast-adapt README · Provenance and division of work：A fleet-wide sweep after a host upgrade goes to upstream's [plugin-fleet-sweep](https://github.com/oh-my-dsh/dsh-plugin-upgrade-skill/tree/main/skills/plugin-fleet-sweep) (breadth), and each flagged plugin comes back to this project's six-step pipeline for a deep pass (depth). For historical corridors the official guide does not cover (before v0.1.7-rc.2), this project's SOP references upstream's cards and scripts — segments with a guide use this project's `code-scan`, segments without use upstream's `plan-migration.mjs` and cards, and runtime verification uses upstream's `verify-runtime.mjs` (directly bridgeable via this project's `run.mjs --real-smoke`).
